shots.detail_en: close-up, a mop sweeping the trading hall floor at dawn, the camera tilting up the handle to CH's eyes fixed on the giant flip-board screen
shots.sub: 在联华，我扫了三个月的地，也记了三个月的盘。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: wide shot, the hall doors opening and the retail crowd flooding in, the big board lighting up with the 联华实业 listing
shots.sub: 联华实业，今天挂牌上市。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: medium shot, MANCANG rushing through the crowd and grabbing CH's shoulder, CH still holding his mop
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: medium shot, CH mopping without looking up while MANCANG circles him pleading
shots.sub: 我在上班。你到底想干嘛？
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: close-up, MANCANG unwrapping a cloth bundle from his chest layer by layer, revealing a worn bankbook
medium two-shot, MANCANG stuffing the bankbook into CH's pocket and CH pushing it back, comic tug of war
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: close-up, MANCANG pressing the bankbook down on the counter with both hands, pleading face
shots.sub: 十万，全给你！条件——带我发财！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: medium shot, CH staring at the bankbook figure, jaw tightening, then glancing at the big board
shots.sub: 好。但我有条件——亏了别哭。
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: medium shot at the retail counter, the broker looking up at CH's janitor uniform, CH deadpan
shots.speaker: 经纪（画外）、长

shots.detail_en: rapid four-beat montage: the board surging at the open / hidden sell orders slamming 联华实业 down / the retail crowd panic-selling / CH calmly keying buy orders at the bottom, escalating edit rhythm
shots.sub: 它在洗盘，不是崩盘。洗盘，洗的就是人心。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: close-up, MANCANG collapsed on a stool watching the board flip back into red, disbelief turning to ecstasy
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: medium shot on the VIP mezzanine, XIONGWEI frowning into his walkie-talkie over a stack of trade reports
shots.sub: 爹，有人在底部接我们砸的货。手笔……不像散户。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: close-up, XIONG lowering his teacup, gaze drifting down to the retail floor
medium shot, the retail crowd swarming CH and calling him stock god while MANCANG shields him with spread arms
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: medium shot, XIONG slowly clapping as he walks toward CH through the dispersing crowd
shots.sub: 好胆识。可惜——联华，不是你能碰的。
shots.speaker: 熊
shots.fx: 一个人的掌声在静场里

shots.detail_en: medium two-shot, CH and XIONG locking eyes, neither yielding
shots.sub: 谢谢熊先生的洗盘，替我把带血的筹码都洗便宜了。
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: flashback insert of an old photograph: a young FATHER and a young XIONG standing in the same trading hall a decade ago, aged paper texture, worn photo edges
close-up back in the present, XIONG narrowing his eyes watching CH walk away
shots.sub: 他像一个人。一个我以为已经死了的人。
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: wide shot at night, CH and MANCANG sitting on the exchange steps sharing steamed buns, city lights behind
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.card: 他不知道的是——十年前那个人，也说过同一句话。
